name: ChipOS Mark II
purpose: AI-powered operating system for AR smart glasses with live captions, HUD, and context awareness. Built for XREAL and Android with accessibility features.
current_blocker: No working end-to-end demo that a stranger can try on actual XREAL glasses yet.
next_task: Build the absolute minimum HUD plus live captions demo that runs on XREAL glasses.
next_milestone: Stranger can put on the glasses and see live captions plus a basic HUD within 15 minutes of setup.
fastest_route_to_revenue: Early access paid beta for accessibility-focused AR users and developers.
time_to_first_sale: 6-10 weeks if we ship a testable version fast
